capture_scripts.hw9_runtime.gd:
extends Node

const SCENE := preload("res://scenes/world/reval_city/reval_city.tscn")
const OUT := "res://build/hw9"
var _city: Node

func _ready() -> void:
	call_deferred("_run")

func _run() -> void:
	_city = SCENE.instantiate()
	get_tree().root.add_child(_city)
	for i in 4:
		await get_tree().process_frame
	var spots := [["hw9_rt_castle_bailey", Vector2(-445, 160)], ["hw9_rt_lossi_plats", Vector2(-372, 172)], ["hw9_rt_kohtu", Vector2(-262, 8)], ["hw9_rt_toom_kooli", Vector2(-383, 30)], ["hw9_rt_kal_village", Vector2(45, -860)], ["hw9_rt_kal_beach", Vector2(115, -862)], ["hw9_rt_kal_lane", Vector2(85, -800)]]
	for sp in spots:
		_city.player.global_position = CityPlan.to_logic(sp[1])
		_city.runtime.cycle_progress = 0.45
		_city._npcs.citizens.hour_override = 10.0
		await get_tree().create_timer(7.0).timeout
		_city.runtime.cycle_progress = 0.45
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await get_tree().process_frame
		var npcs := _city.find_child("CityNpcs", true, false)
		print("%s live_citizens=%d" % [sp[0], npcs.citizens.live_count() if npcs else -1])
		var image := get_tree().root.get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
		image.save_png(ProjectSettings.globalize_path("%s/%s.png" % [OUT, sp[0]]))
		print("captured ", sp[0])
	get_tree().quit(0)
